latest.title: Z-Deck 0.2.64-cyberdeck

preUpdateBackup.reason: A/B app-only OTA does not write NVS, LittleFS, or SD; manual SD backup remains available as a separate queued action.

latest.notes: Replaces launcher paging with six large direct controls matching the sketch: Alerts, Map, Messages, Contacts, Tools, and Settings. The compact header and footer keep clock, battery, mesh, GPS, SD, and unread state visible. App-only A/B OTA never overwrites MeshCore, NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, or local preferences.
